villageLost.beat: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

The audience wants to know — what should WE do with them? ...Well? You're the Bearer. SAY something. The cameras are RIGHT here."
(The pods need an answer. Speak for them — it will cost you — or let the segment play.)

lossDayLines.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.
The first night of Winter. A day ends at the fire; a season ends there too, only longer. The village sits up late.
